title: Azhagarsamy
desc: Thayama gets money from a landlord in order to save her husband and promises to give her child in return. Things turn for the worst when the rich man wants to marry off his daughter to Thayama's son.

title: Pullakuttikaran
desc: Ammu, a young girl, falls in love with Veeraiyan, a pickpocket, and marries him. Later, their past troubles with an evil politician catch up to them.

title: Thangamana Purushan
desc: Raja and Subalatha fall in love with each other. However, Raja's father, Aldapu Arumugam, and Subalatha's mother, Kanchanamala, are both extremely greedy and refuse to accept their relationship.

title: Bharathi
desc: A biographical account of the life of the Indian freedom fighter, Mahakavi Subramaniya Bharathiar, who defied conventional norms to bring equality in society.

title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.
